description: Ventas Gas Natural - Volúmenes por zona geográfica is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by ANCAP. Ventas de gas natural por zona geográfica, abiertas por Transporte Firme, Transporte Interrumpible y Gas Consumido, en m3. Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher ANCAP. Its tags are ANCAP, Gas Natural, Ventas, Volúmenes, Zona Geográfica. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
